verdict.register_evidence: Bugs: off-by-one (idx == len is out of bounds, valid indices 0..len-1), no check for negative idx (idx < 0 leads to out-of-bounds read before the buffer)
verdict.notes: The surfaced thinking correctly identifies both planted bugs. The final output incorrectly says positive indices generally pass when len is negative; the guard actually rejects positive idx because idx > len.
